# Vendored ch58x PAC

`ch58x-hal` main requires `ch58x` 0.4.0, which is not published on crates.io yet.
This is the crate generated by [ch32-rs](https://github.com/ch32-rs/ch32-rs)
`main` @ 110527e (`./scripts/generate.sh ch58x`, svd2rust 0.37.1).

Replace with `ch58x = { version = "0.4.0", ... }` in Cargo.toml and delete
`vendor/ch58x` once it is published.
